paper.title_en: Local obstructions to trapped-region escape in modified gravity
paper.abstract_en: Energy conditions in modified gravity are commonly imposed on an ''effective'' stress tensor that mixes physical matter with additional gravitational degrees of freedom, obscuring which sector actually controls null focusing, horizon multiplicity, and the disappearance of trapped regions. We develop a geometry-first alternative in spherical symmetry. For a normalized pair of future-directed radial null vectors, twolongitudinal Ricci projections and one independent transverse Einstein projection obey exact area-weighted transport laws. These imply a trapping-persistence theorem: after a nondegenerate future-outer marginal sphere, a regular ingoing generator cannot exit the trapped region while the ingoing longitudinal and transverse convergence channels remain nonnegative. In metric $f(R)$ gravity, with $F\equiv df/dR>0$, we then construct an entropy-resolved hierarchy based on the local Wald-density variable $Fr^2$. In the longitudinal entropy-focusing law, the scalaron second derivative cancels exactly, leaving a nonpositive scalar-gradient square together with the physical matter projection; in the independent transverse entropy-transport law, all scalaron derivative terms cancel. Entropy trapping is consequently governed by the physical matter condition $T_{nn}\geq 0$ and an algebraic mixed threshold rather than by a fictitious effective fluid. The resulting hierarchy cleanly separates matter positivity, geometric focusing, marginal-surface recovery, and gravitational-entropy evolution, and identifies the precise local reversals required for regular inner horizons, throats, and trapped-to-antitrapped transitions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在球对称下以几何优先方式处理陷获区与引力熵，针对f(R)引力构造了熵分辨的层级与输运律，强调纵向标量子二阶导消去、横向导数全部抵消，并明确物质正性与几何聚焦的分离。问题设定清晰、理论分析具体，涉及黑洞热力学与引力熵核心议题，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 修正引力中陷获区逃逸的局部阻碍
decision.abstract_zh: 修正引力中的能量条件通常被施加在一个“有效”应力张量上，该张量将物理物质与额外的引力自由度混合在一起，从而模糊了究竟是哪一个扇区实际控制零测地线的聚焦、视界的多重性以及陷获区的消失。我们在球对称情形下发展了一种几何优先的替代方案。对于一对归一化的未来指向径向零矢量，两个纵向Ricci投影和一个独立的横向Einstein投影满足精确的面积加权输运定律。由此可推出一个陷获持续性定理：在一个非退化的未来外边缘球面之后，只要入射纵向和横向会聚通道保持非负，一个正则的入射生成元就无法逃出陷获区。在度规$f(R)$引力中，当$F\equiv df/dR>0$时，我们进而基于局部Wald密度变量$Fr^2$构造了一个熵分辨的层级结构。在纵向熵聚焦定律中，标量子的二阶导数精确抵消，只留下一个非正标量梯度平方项以及物理物质的投影；在独立的横向熵输运定律中，所有标量子导数项均抵消。因此，熵陷获由物理物质条件$T_{nn}\geq 0$以及一个代数混合阈值所支配，而不是由一个虚构的有效流体支配。由此得到的层级结构清晰地区分了物质正性、几何聚焦、边缘球面恢复以及引力熵演化，并识别出为实现正则内视界、喉部以及从陷获到反陷获转变所需的精确局部反转。
